# netcup_user_iso (Resource)

An uploaded ISO of the netcup SCP user (SCP REST API). The provider uploads `source` on create, and `destroy` deletes it. netcup refuses an upload to an existing `key`, so a new value of `source_hash` replaces the ISO, and without `source_hash` the provider cannot see changes of the file. The API cannot abort an upload, so a failed one leaves its parts at netcup.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netcup_user_iso" "example" {
  key         = "install.iso"
  source      = "${path.module}/install.iso"
  source_hash = filesha256("${path.module}/install.iso")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Name of the ISO at netcup.
- `source` (String) Path of the local file. Changing only the path uploads nothing.

### Optional

- `source_hash` (String) Any value that changes with the file, e.g. `filesha256("disk.img")`. A new value replaces the object, also the first one after an import. Removing it changes nothing at netcup.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Equals `key`.
- `last_modified` (String) Time of the last change.
- `size_in_b` (Number) Size in bytes.
- `type` (String) `DISK`, `SNAPSHOT`, `BACKUP` or `MANUAL`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import format: <key>
terraform import netcup_user_iso.example install.iso
```
